---
name: Model / parser request
about: Ask PatchQ to understand a new lockfile, manifest, or scanner report format
labels: parser-request
---

**File type** (e.g. `pnpm-lock.yaml`, `uv.lock`, `Cargo.lock`, CycloneDX SBOM, Grype SARIF)

**Ecosystem / where it comes from** (tool + version that writes it)

**A small sample file** (attach or paste; strip anything private)

**How many projects in your stack use it?** (helps prioritize — parsers are one small file + tests each)

**Workaround today?** (e.g. you run osv-scanner and `--import` the JSON)
